data.sampling: First train/validation/test counts from one deterministic permutation of unordered node pairs; both directions stay together; remaining pairs unused.
data.training_budget: Report samples scale linearly with node count, preserving the 32-node average samples per node and epochs; all nodes must appear in training.

training.initialization: Independent fresh adapters for each fixed graph; no 32-node adapter reuse.
training.prefix_validation: FP32 full-versus-cached loss and adapter gradients on 64 nodes. BF16 split-prefill changes numerical rounding and is not claimed bitwise equivalent to 32-node full-sequence training; formal precision remains BF16 for both adapters.
training.checkpoint_selection: Same validation report accuracy, then loss, then earliest epoch as base configuration.

evaluation.state_information: Identical full textual adjacency/current/goal in every condition; augmented conditions add current/goal Q tokens.
evaluation.generation_and_scoring: Inherit matched augmentation configuration, including 4096 new tokens and semantic decision review.
evaluation.report_readout: Selected adapters also report heldout current/goal IDs without textual IDs; no action labels used in training or selection.
evaluation.begin_after: Both adapters for a graph finish training and checkpoint selection.

interpretation: One existing random seed-0 graph per size. Size also changes topology, graph distances and training compute; compare matched augmentation gains within each size. No pure node-count causal effect or cross-graph transfer claim. Multi-template training and extra controls remain deferred.
